column3: Please move the design review to Thursday at ten.
Add milk, eggs and two loaves of bread to the list.

Thanks for sending the draft yesterday. I read it twice and I think the structure works well. The second section is a little long, so I would cut the history part down to one paragraph. Could you also add the cost table we talked about on Monday? If you can send a new version by Friday, I will review it over the weekend and we can meet early next week.

Here is the plan for the garden this spring. First we clear the old leaves from the back beds and turn the soil. Then we plant tomatoes, beans and a row of lettuce near the fence where it gets morning sun. The herbs go in pots on the patio. We should water every second day unless it rains, and check for slugs after dark.

I want to share a short update on the move to the new office, because a few people have asked about the timeline. The lease starts on the first of next month, and the building team will hand over the keys a week before that. We plan to move in three stages. The first stage is the shared spaces: the kitchen, the meeting rooms and the reception desk. Those need new furniture, and the order is already placed. The second stage is the desks for the product and design teams, who will move on a Friday so that nobody loses a working day. The third stage is everyone else, the week after. Each person will get a box and a label with their new desk number. Please pack your own things, but leave monitors, docks and chairs where they are, because the movers will handle those. If you have equipment that needs special care, such as a large printer or a test rig, tell the facilities team by the end of this week. Parking at the new site is limited, so we are adding bike racks and a monthly transit pass for anyone who wants one. The cafe on the ground floor will give a small discount to staff for the first three months. We will hold a short welcome lunch on the first full day, and there will be a tour for anyone who wants to learn where things are. If you have questions, reply to this message or ask in the office channel, and I will collect the answers in one place.
